record.field: Liber: put Home first and point the root at it

# Puts the Liber menus in a sensible order and points the root at the home page. # Pure data action, so it also runs when the module is installed through # Apps > Import Module, which strips Python. ORDER = [("home", 10), ("brands", 30), ("blog", 40), ("about", 50), ("contact", 60)] Website = env["website"].sudo() Menu = env["website.menu"].sudo() Page = env["website.page"].sudo()
sites = Website.search([]).filtered( lambda w: "liber" in (w.name or "").lower() or "liberholdings" in (w.domain or "").lower() ) if not sites: sites = Website.search([], limit=1)
report = [] FLAGS = ("x_rbc_theme_active", "x_tc_theme_active", "x_tooling_theme_active", "x_tooling_components_theme_active") for site in sites: # Liber Holdings is view-only (Dale, 9 Oct 2026): no catalog in its menu. Siblings and Liber Industrial untouched. holding = ("industrial" not in (site.name or "").lower()) and not any(f in site._fields and site[f] for f in FLAGS) if holding: catalog = Menu.search([("website_id", "=", site.id), ("url", "=like", "/shop%")]) if catalog: report.append("%s: %s catalog menu entry(ies) removed" % (site.name, len(catalog))) catalog.unlink() menus = Menu.search([("website_id", "=", site.id), ("parent_id", "!=", False)]) home = menus.filtered(lambda m: (m.url or "") in ("/", "/home")) page = Page.search([ ("url", "in", ["/home", "/"]), ("website_id", "in", [site.id, False]), ("is_published", "=", True), ], order="url desc", limit=1)
# A Home entry has to exist before it can be put first if not home and page: top = Menu.search([("website_id", "=", site.id), ("parent_id", "=", False)], limit=1) if top: home = Menu.create({ "name": "Home", "url": page.url, "parent_id": top.id, "website_id": site.id, "sequence": 10, }) report.append("%s: Home entry created at %s" % (site.name, page.url))
for menu in menus | home: url = (menu.url or "").lower() name = (menu.name or "").lower() seq = None for key, value in ORDER: if key == "home" and (url in ("/", "/home") or name in ("home", "inicio")): seq = value elif key != "home" and (key in url or key in name): seq = value if seq is not None: break if seq is not None and menu.sequence != seq: menu.write({"sequence": seq})
if page and "homepage_url" in site._fields and site.homepage_url != page.url: site.write({"homepage_url": page.url}) report.append("%s: root now serves %s" % (site.name, page.url))
# More than one Contact entry: keep one contacts = Menu.search([("website_id", "=", site.id), ("parent_id", "!=", False), ("url", "in", ["/contactus", "/contact"])], order="sequence, id") if len(contacts) > 1: extra = contacts[1:] report.append("%s: %s duplicate Contact entry(ies) removed" % (site.name, len(extra))) extra.unlink()
# More than one Home entry: keep the first and remove the rest homes = Menu.search([("website_id", "=", site.id), ("parent_id", "!=", False), ("url", "in", ["/", "/home"])], order="sequence, id") if len(homes) > 1: extra = homes[1:] report.append("%s: %s duplicate Home entry(ies) removed" % (site.name, len(extra))) extra.unlink()
order = Menu.search([("website_id", "=", site.id), ("parent_id", "!=", False)], order="sequence, id") report.append("%s: %s" % (site.name, " > ".join(order.mapped("name"))))
action = { "type": "ir.actions.client", "tag": "display_notification", "params": {"title": "Liber menu order", "type": "success", "sticky": True, "message": " | ".join(report) or "Nothing to change."}, }
